note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 31 May 1911: six contests. "The Newry No. 2 Rural District Council now consists of the following 24 elected members (two for each division)" (Newry Reporter, 3 June 1911, p. 7). No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. Thomas O'Hare: no party label printed in 1911. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Camlough, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1905, printed 'N': Frontier Sentinel, 29 April 1905, p. 8 ("Armagh County Council": further nominations); Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Nominations: County Councillors"); Camlough, Armagh County Council, 28 May 1914, listed as Nationalist: Portadown News, 2 May 1914, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Armagh County Council"); Newry Reporter, 28 April 1914, p. 5 ("Armagh County Council: Nominations")).
